title: Purrlend (HyperEVM + MegaETH): fresh unprivileged extractable $0; privileged keys cap at $595.54 idle
closed_reasons: All 13 reserves across both chains are paused (config bit 60); every value function (supply/withdraw/borrow/repay/flashLoan/liquidationCall) requires !isPaused and reverts RESERVE_PAUSED ('29') — fork-proven
No BRIDGE holder exists on either chain; the Apr-2026 attacker's roles were revoked 2026-04-25 (HyperEVM block 33,394,150; MegaETH block 14,304,738)
grantRole is standard OZ AccessControl: getRoleAdmin(BRIDGE)=DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; a fresh address calling grantRole reverts 'missing role 0x00..00' (eth_call + fork verified)

mintUnbacked is onlyBridge (ACLManager.isBridge -> hasRole(BRIDGE)); a fresh caller reverts CALLER_NOT_BRIDGE ('6'); even a BRIDGE holder needs the reserve unpaused because executeMintUnbacked calls validateSupply

No unprotected initializer / proxy takeover from outside: Pool proxy initialized, ACLManager non-upgradeable (3,639 bytes), AddressesProvider Ownable with owner = Safe (fresh setACLManager reverts 'Ownable: caller is not the owner')
Zero idle liquidity for a fresh attacker: the only underlying held by aToken contracts is 420.05 sUSDp ($420.06) + 175.48 GLV ($175.48) + dust; all other reserves hold 0
The incident attacker's 5.495M aUSDC / 2.100M aUSDm are phantom claims: the aToken contracts hold 0 underlying; withdraw reverts even after an admin unpause (fork-proven)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live from Purrlend: all 13 reserves on HyperEVM+MegaETH are paused (even repay), no BRIDGE/POOL_ADMIN holder exists, grantRole/mintUnbacked are properly gated, and zero idle liquidity exists; the privileged exposure is real but capped at $595.54 (420.05 sUSDp + 175.48 GLV) behind a single-key DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA (both chains) and the old 2-of-3 Safe (provider owner both chains, DEFAULT_ADMIN MegaETH), with ~$14.5M nominal claims and ~$6.9M unbacked phantom having no cash behind them.
